title: Nutty Middle-Eastern Chicken Upside-Down Pot
description: A resinous, molten, and comforting Middle-Eastern dish featuring dark chocolate, shio-koji-cured chicken, and Mediterranean spices.

ingredients.name: Boneless chicken thighs
ingredients.notes: preferably with bone for added flavor

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together shio-koji, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken thighs, making sure to coat them evenly.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken thighs until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set it aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sauté the sliced onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the dark chocolate chips and cook for 1-2 minutes, until melted and fragrant.
Return the chicken thighs to the skillet and spoon some of the chocolate-onion mixture over each piece.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is bubbly and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Let the pot rest for 10 minutes before serving.
